title: Harry Roque's asylum request denied, says DILG's Remulla
summary: The asylum request of former presidential spokesperson Harry Roque has been denied, Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla said Tuesday.

blocks.text: The asylum request of former presidential spokesperson Harry Roque has been denied, Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla said Tuesday.
“By the way, tapos na 'yung asylum, na-deny 'yung asylum ni Harry Roque. Tapos na 'yung five months. Kung may red notice na, kukunin ko siya,” Remulla said in a press briefing.
He added that he will bring Roque back to the Philippines once there is a red notice against the latter. —AOL, GMA News
